author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಗತಿಯಿಲ್ಲ ತಮಗೆಂದು ನಂಬಿಸುತ ನಟಿಸುವರು
ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಇಡುಗಂಟು ಕೂಡಿಸುತಲಿಹರು
ಪತಿರಾಗುವರವರು ನಿಜಮುಖವು ಹೊರಹೊಮ್ಮೆ
ಮಿತಿಯಿರದೆ ಕನಲಿಪರು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They act as if they have nothing and make you believe it,
they become chaff once their true face comes out,
and then they rage without limit, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Some people plead poverty while hoarding in secret. Once their real face is seen they lose all worth, and often turn bitter and angry.
